reviews.comment:
My girls stayed with Jimmy and Soph this past weekend while we visited family in Spain. It was their first time staying since their trial, and it was such a relief knowing they were safe, happy, and so well cared for. Jimmy and Soph welcomed them into their beautiful home as if they were their own dogs, which meant the world to us.

The daily updates were perfect, a wonderful mix of videos and photos, allowing us to see exactly what they were getting up to. Being able to watch their body language and how relaxed and joyful they were truly put us at ease. Our oldest girl is 12 and rarely settles anywhere outside her own home, yet she absolutely loved it there and bonded so well with Ralphy, their lovely dog.

They enjoyed gorgeous walks, endless cuddles and tickles, and the kind of care that goes far above expectations. We wouldn’t hesitate for a moment to use Jimmy and Soph again, and we feel incredibly relieved to have found such a special place for our dogs to stay when we’re away.

Highly, highly recommend The Bark Bungalow to anyone.

reviews.comment:
Jimmy & Sophie are an absolute dream team! Our pup Memphis has been having a weekly walk with them for a few months now, for socialisation & fun and we’ve also put Memphis in for daycare occasionally when work commitments clash.

Memphis absolutely loves hanging out with the gang, Jimmy always sends videos and pictures and it’s clear to see how much fun Memphis is having but what is equally evident is how much Jimmy and Sophie love every dog they look after and genuinely enjoy being with them. They know each dog’s personality and abilities and they’re clearly knowledgeable of dog behaviours etc. They genuinely love what they do.

Jimmy, with our consent, has been working with Memphis’s recall off lead and that has given us the confidence to continue that recall work. Memphis loves running with the pack and being able to be a big boy off lead with his buddies.  Their own dog Ralph has even taught Memphis to swim!

Sophie is also Memphis’ regular stylist and does an absolute wonderful job with him, making the grooming process a positive experience every time. Again, her love of dogs is abundantly clear and she takes such good care of our boy.

I honestly cannot praise Jimmy & Sophie enough, the love and care they show Memphis (and all the dogs in their care) is priceless. We have no hesitation whatsoever in entrusting our sweet boy to their care. Nothing is too much trouble and they’ve helped us out at short notice without any stress.

Memphis loves Jimmy, Soph & Ralph. I hope they’ll be lifelong friends 🐾

reviewReply.comment: Hi Laura, thank you so much for your lovely detailed review. We’ve absolutely loved having Memphis and having him here at the bark bungalow. He always has so much fun and we can’t wait to have him again soon.

reviews.comment:
We’ve just collected our dog Coco from a two week home boarding holiday with Jimmy, Sophie and their beautiful dog Ralphy at the bark bungalow. We were very nervous about leaving him as we’d left him in kennels and having no updates on walks, food and general welfare we did not want to go down that route again. Jimmy met us for a walk then showed around their stunning home in Sully. After a successful trial we were so happy to leave Coco and could not wait for his holiday. Coco is very nervous around other dogs and Jimmy assured us that all dogs are vetted on a trial basis and they accept no aggressive dogs. We had extra reassurances when we found out they are licensed and inspected by the vale of Glamorgan council.

Coco had such a great time with his friends that he didn’t want to leave the door step. We can’t thank Jimmy & Sophie enough for providing a holiday for coco just as good as ours.

reviewReply.comment: Hi Xerxes, we absolutely loved having Coco. He had such a good time bless him. We cannot wait to have him again soon.
